subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should #99586 be scoped first as a gateway/session lifecycle root-cause investigation, a tool-result/output contract repair, or a new operator recovery/status surface?
rationale: The central bug is real enough to keep open, but the current evidence spans multiple runtime boundaries and the issue already requests recovery UX that may be a product choice rather than the root fix.

options.title: Root-cause live logs first
options.body: Use the July 5 reporter logs and AS76 live session to isolate the exact gateway/session lifecycle or tool-result path before queueing code changes.

options.title: Sponsor recovery surface
options.body: Define a supported self-rescue/status command such as session reset or tools_status only after deciding the operator contract and permissions.

options.title: Fold into broader wedge tracker
options.body: Move this under an existing session-wedge epic only if maintainers choose a canonical cluster owner and preserve this issue's blank-body evidence.

recommendation.title: Root-cause live logs first
recommendation.body: Use the July 5 reporter logs and AS76 live session to isolate the exact gateway/session lifecycle or tool-result path before queueing code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The most directly adjacent recent history combines session-lock retry, empty tool-result behavior, and post-report output/runtime hardening.
